_comment: Judge registry for E1-v2. Identity (deployment, model id, API version) and credentials come from the environment ONLY; this file names the variables, never their values. Request parameters are per judge because reasoning-model deployments reject a temperature override and take max_completion_tokens instead of max_tokens. Every request parameter here can be overridden by the matching *_TEMPERATURE / *_TOKEN_PARAM / *_MAX_TOKENS / *_REASONING_EFFORT environment variable (value 'none' omits the parameter). The exact parameters sent are recorded on every verdict.

secondary.label: gpt4o-v4
secondary._note: The validated v4 'reasoned + strip' judge used for the real E3 sweep (azure-openai/gpt-4o@2025-01-01-preview). Falls back to the AZURE_OPENAI_* variables the E3 runner reads.
